stepExplanation:
Finding current:
$$I = \frac{\varepsilon}{R + r} = \frac{12}{5.5 + 0.5} = \frac{12}{6} = 2 \text{ A}$$

Finding terminal voltage:
$$V = IR = (2)(5.5) = 11 \text{ V}$$

Alternatively: V = ε - Ir = 12 - (2)(0.5) = 12 - 1 = 11 V
stepBody: Use ε = I(R + r) to find current, then V = IR for terminal voltage. Give current in A and voltage in V.
